build_dir.description: Path to the build directory containing plan.json, e.g. .sfskills/builds/case-onboarding/.

step_id.description: Id of the single step to run. Must appear in plan.json steps[], and in the output of `build_plan.py next` unless it is a `failed` or `blocked` step being re-run with `reason` (AGENT.md Step 2 carve-out). Must match the `M<n>-S<nn>` form (e.g. M1-S04) that agents/_shared/schemas/build-plan.schema.json requires.

reason.description: Optional free text recorded on the run when a step is re-run after a blocked or failed exit.
